title: Success Manager - Partner Insights & Enablement
description:
Success Manager - Partner Insights & Enablement

Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’ s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.

Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest, but we have employees who live across the country.  Our team enjoys the flexibility of a hybrid model and working from anywhere.

For overall team productivity, we optimize meeting hours in the pacific time zone. We avoid scheduling recurring meetings that start after 3pm PT, however, ad hoc meetings occur between 8am-6pm Pacific time. #LI-remote

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you. 

The Opportunity

The Customer Success Manager will sit within the Success team on the Partner Insights, Enablement and Success team. This role will own strategic customer relationships with healthcare systems, life sciences organizations, and research partners, helping customers translate complex clinical questions into successful real-world data and evidence workflows. The ideal candidate combines enterprise healthcare technology customer success experience - especially experience with EMR data or EMR vendors - with a strong foundation in clinical practice, real-world data or evidence, public health, outcomes research, or epidemiology. 

Responsibilities:

  • Own a portfolio of Truveta customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, research execution, renewal readiness, and expansion. Develop success plans, establish measurable outcomes, and ensure customers realize sustained value from Truveta. 
  • Guide customers through research and analytics workflows, including cohort definition, feasibility assessment, study design considerations, data interpretation, and effective use of Truveta products and services. 
  • Translate customer goals, clinical workflows, and research questions into clear requirements, action plans, and deliverables. Coordinate across product, research, engineering, commercial, and support teams to drive resolution and progress. 
  • Manage customer education, enablement, training, and stakeholder and executive-ready communications. Clearly summarize research findings, product capabilities, risks, and recommendations in Truveta-branded reports, slide decks, and presentations. 
  • Build trusted relationships with clinical, operational, informatics, analytics, and research stakeholders at health systems and life sciences organizations. Serve as a strategic advisor and customer advocate. 
  • Identify opportunities to deepen product adoption and expand customer impact. Partner with commercial teams on account planning, renewal preparation, and growth opportunities. 
  • Proactively identify delivery, workflow, or adoption risks and develop practical recommendations for resolution. 
  • Occasional but mandatory domestic travel (~2-5x/yr), plus the ability to attend virtual meetings across US time zones. 

Required Skills:

  • 4+ years of experience working in a field which developed exposure to and understanding of electronic medical record (EMR) data, real-world data (RWD), real world evidence (RWE), public health research, or regulatory submissions. 
  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, consulting, ideally with a focus on life science or healthcare analytics customers. 
  • Demonstrated experience with public health research, epidemiology, outcomes research, health services research, real-world data (RWD), real-world evidence (RWE), or clinical research. 
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to align clinical, technical, operational, and executive audiences around shared goals and deliverables. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain scientific, analytical, and technical concepts to audiences with varying levels of familiarity. 
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, navigate ambiguity, and manage multiple customer priorities simultaneously. 
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to timely, high-quality execution. 
  • High degree of professionalism, curiosity, empathy, and enthusiasm for Truveta's mission of Saving Lives with Data. 
  • Direct experience working at an EMR vendor, or substantial experience implementing, supporting, or advising customers on Epic or Cerner platforms and workflows is an absolute plus.

Preferred Qualifications: 

These qualifications are preferred but not required, please do not let them stop you from applying for this role. You will likely get the opportunity to learn how to do these more advanced analyses if you don’t already have experience with them.  

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in public health, epidemiology, health services research, biomedical informatics, biostatistics, health economics, or another quantitative or health-related discipline. 
  • Experience supporting health systems, life sciences organizations, academic researchers, or government/public health customers using clinical data for research, quality improvement, or evidence generation. 
  • Experience with clinical data models, EHR workflows, interoperability, population health, registries, analytics, or clinical informatics. 
  • Experience with statistical analysis or querying tools such as SQL, R, Python, or similar technologies. 

Why Truveta?   

Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together.

  • Great benefits package
  • Comprehensive benefits with strong medical, dental and vision insurance plans
  • 401K plan
  • Professional development & training opportunities for continuous learning
  • Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off
  • Generous parental leave
  • Regular team activities (virtual and in-person as soon as we are able)
  • The base pay for this position is $105,000 to $130,000. The pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target. Pay is based on several factors including location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles are eligible for additional compensation such as incentive pay and stock options.

title: Oncology Trial Navigator
description:
About the Role

The Oncology Trial Navigator will play a critical role in connecting Signatera patients to life-changing clinical trial opportunities. As a front-line clinical expert, you will be responsible for the end-to-end execution of patient matching workflows—from initial AI-enabled screening to successful enrollment at a clinical trial site.

You will serve as the primary clinical point of contact for external stakeholders, including treating oncologists, principal investigators (PIs), and research coordinators. This role combines deep oncology clinical knowledge with high-touch stakeholder engagement in a fast-scaling, mission-driven environment. You will work closely with the Senior Manager of Oncology Trial Navigation to pilot and refine the navigation service, providing the "on-the-ground" insights necessary to scale this function across the oncology domain.

What You’ll Do

Physician & Site Engagement

  • Conduct high-volume, structured outreach to oncologists, PIs, and research coordinators regarding trial-eligible patients identified through Natera’s platforms.
  • Act as a clinical consultant to research sites, delivering patient eligibility notifications and facilitating seamless referral workflows.
  • Track patient progression from initial identification through referral and enrollment, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution of site-level bottlenecks.

Trial Matching & Medical Review

  • Operationalize outputs from Natera’s AI-enabled trial matching platform to manage a daily priority queue of potential matches.
  • Perform rigorous clinical reviews, reconciling patient molecular data (e.g., MRD status, biomarkers) and exome results with trial-specific inclusion/exclusion criteria.
  • Collaborate with the Clinical Product team to provide real-time feedback on matching accuracy, helping to refine AI algorithms and data filters.

Patient & Caregiver Support (as applicable)

  • Provide high-level, empathetic, and compliant education to patients regarding specific clinical trial opportunities and the clinical significance of their molecular results.
  • Coordinate warm handoffs to site research teams, ensuring patients feel supported and informed throughout the referral process.

 

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain meticulous documentation of all outreach and referral activities within CRM and tracking tools.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Participate in cross-functional collaboration with internal partners to optimize the field.

 

Qualifications

Education & Licensure:

  • Current, active licensure as a Registered Nurse (RN), Certified Genetic Counselor (CGC), Nurse Practitioner (NP), or Physician Assistant (PA).
    • Must maintain licensure in good standing throughout employment.
    • Board Certification (e.g., OCN, CCRC, or similar) is highly preferred.
  • A master’s degree in a clinical or scientific field is preferred.

Professional Experience:

  • 3–5 years of oncology clinical experience, with at least 2 years specifically in oncology clinical research (e.g., as a Research Nurse, Coordinator, or Navigator).
  • Proven experience in patient identification and trial matching services, ideally within a molecular diagnostics or biotech environment.
  • Experience communicating complex clinical and genomic information to physicians, PIs, and patients.

Clinical Expertise:

  • Strong clinical knowledge of oncology, with a focus on biomarker-driven therapies and MRD-based clinical trial landscapes.
  • Expert-level understanding of clinical trial design and the ability to interpret complex inclusion/exclusion criteria.

Technical & Data Proficiency:

  • Technology Adoption: Ability to quickly master new AI-enabled matching tools and digital health platforms.
  • Data Literacy: Comfort navigating large clinical datasets and translating patient records into structured eligibility requirements.
  • Systems Advocacy: Proactive in identifying workflow inefficiencies and suggesting technological or process-based solutions.

Core Competencies:

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
  • High degree of empathy and professionalism in patient-facing interactions.
  • Strong organizational skills and follow through discipline.
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish preferred.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. 

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

title: Alliance Partner Manager (SaaS) | Luma
description:
Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need

We are seeking an Alliance Partner Manager to lead the technical dimension of our alliances and partnering function for Luma, our AI-Native Multimodal Research Platform for Scientific Intelligence. Sitting at the intersection of business and engineering, you'll own how our platform connects with, integrates into, and creates value alongside the products of our strategic technology partners, such as Databricks and AWS.

This position is based in EMEA, working globally across time zones. It is a senior role with broad scope, where you'll act as the bridge between partner engineering teams and our own product, engineering and commercial organizations, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales, as well as colleagues at Siemens, with room to design and build the technical alliance capability around you.

While the focus is strategic, this remains a hands-on role: you'll need enough technical depth to scope integrations credibly, validate them in sandboxes, and hold your own in a conversation with a partner's engineering team. We're looking for someone with an engineering-minded, "application scientist" type approach — comfortable understanding the technical requirements involved in onboarding a partner, and operating confidently within a large company mindset and environment.

In this role you will get to:

  • Define, build, and execute the technical partner strategy, prioritising which integrations and joint solutions to build, developing and implementing joint go-to-market plans (co-sell, co-build, co-deliver), aligning teams and facilitating sales enablement and training of partners.
  • Own engineering level relationships across partner organisations through effective communication, structured governance and business reviews, and joint business planning.
  • Scope integration feasibility early in partner conversations, translating vague partner asks into clear, buildable technical specifications and setting realistic expectations.
  • Oversee solution architecture, use-case mapping, partner product certification and sandbox / proof-of-concept development to design and validate joint solutions.
  • Engage partners to develop differentiated solutions through joint collaboration, market and competitive analysis, and the creation of joint marketing collateral.
  • Evangelise partnerships internally, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales stakeholders, and with colleagues at Siemens, feeding partner needs into the roadmap and organising collaborative events.
  • Define, track and analyse key partnership metrics, collaborating with partners to optimise performance, and represent Dotmatics/Siemens at alliance and partner conferences and events.
  • Focus specifically on systems integration partners, bringing on partners that will meaningfully increase the bottom line.

We are looking for candidate's who have 7+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, solution architecture or pre-sales engineering, including several years leading strategic technical partner or ISV relationships at enterprise scale. You've built integrations, not just managed them, and you can move fluently between a business review and a whiteboard session with a partner's engineers. You're comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy on complex, ambiguous pursuits, and you set realistic expectations that engineering can actually deliver on.

Just as importantly, you lead through influence. You can align engineering, marketing and sales teams, internally and across partner organisations, behind a shared plan without direct authority, and you're motivated by building a partnering function and team, not just running one. While not a traditional "sales" person, you're comfortable navigating sales-style conversations, combining technical knowledge with strong relationship management and communication skills.

Key Skills:

  • Technical partnership leadership - a proven track record defining and executing partner or alliance strategy with ISVs, technology platforms or system integrators, with measurable partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue impact.
  • Hands-on integration fluency, including practical depth with APIs, authentication and data-exchange patterns, and the ability to scope, spec and validate integrations through sandboxes and proof-of-concept builds.
  • Joint go-to-market execution - experience developing co-sell, co-build and co-deliver plans, aligning internal and partner teams, facilitating sales enablement and creating the collateral that makes joint solutions land.
  • Executive-level relationship management - comfort owning senior stakeholder relationships across partner organisations, running structured business reviews (QBRs), and resolving conflict constructively when internal and partner priorities clash.
  • Data-driven partner management, with the habit of defining, tracking and analysing partnership KPIs and leading indicators of partner health and acting on them before issues escalate.

You may also have:

  • Experience with cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) or OEM / embedded partnership motions.
  • Experience structuring and negotiating complex commercial and technical agreements alongside legal teams.
  • Familiarity with tiered partner certification programmes.
  • A background or interest in scientific, life-sciences or research software, or another domain-deep industry such as Oil & Gas or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG).

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. 

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

title: Greenhouse ATS Systems Support Analyst

About Inizio

Inizio is a global partner with over 10,500 experts operating in more than 50 countries. We support health and life science companies by turning science into strategy and executing across the product and patient journey. Our services include market research, strategy consulting, transformation consulting, and commercial benchmarking, all designed to be data-backed and patient-inspired.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and systems-focused Greenhouse ATS/ Talent Acquisition Systems Support Analyst to support the administration, maintenance, optimization, and reporting of our recruitment technology ecosystem, with a primary focus on Greenhouse ATS.

This role will serve as the first point of contact for recruitment system support, ensuring recruiters, hiring managers, and HR stakeholders have a seamless experience using our recruiting technologies. The successful candidate will be responsible for system configuration, user support, data integrity, troubleshooting, process documentation, and continuous improvement of recruitment systems and workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Recruitment Systems Administration & Support
• Act as the primary support resource for Greenhouse ATS and related recruitment technologies (Linkedin Recruiter, HireEz, DataPeople etc)
• Maintain role-based permissions and user access across multiple business units and entities.
• Provide day-to-day support to recruiters, hiring managers, HR teams, and other system users.
• Support system testing, upgrades, releases, and implementation of new functionality.
• Create and maintain system documentation, user guides, and knowledge articles.
• Monitor system performance and identify opportunities for optimization and automation.

Integration & Data Management
• Support integrations between Greenhouse, Workday, LinkedIn Recruiter, background screening providers, onboarding platforms, and other recruiting technologies.
• Monitor integration health and investigate data discrepancies between systems.
• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across recruitment platforms.

Process & User Enablement
• Document recruitment system processes and standard operating procedures.
• Deliver system training and onboarding support for recruiters and hiring managers.
• Promote adoption of Greenhouse best practices and new system functionality.
• Partner with Talent Acquisition Operations, HR Operations, and HRIS teams to improve recruitment workflows and user experience.

Required Skills & Experience
• Experience administering or supporting Greenhouse ATS, Workday, or similar HR and recruitment systems.
• Strong understanding of recruitment processes and ATS workflows.
• Experience managing user permissions, templates, workflows, and system configurations.

Dan ben je bij P1 Travel in Leiden aan het goede adres. Wij hebben namelijk een stageplek beschikbaar in het AI-team. Denk aan clubs als Manchester United, Tottenham Hotspur, FC Barcelona en West Ham united, maar ook de Olympische spelen, Formule 1 en Wimbledon. Wij brengen zakelijke en particuliere klanten naar het evenement van hun dromen. Jij kunt hier onderdeel van uitmaken in de vorm van een stage bij ons Finance team. Feeling met sport? Dan wordt deze stage je grootste hobby! Hoe gaat je stage eruitzien? In deze rol werk je samen met verschillende afdelingen om operationele behoeften te identificeren, te begrijpen hoe teams werken, en die inzichten te vertalen naar praktische automatiseringsoplossingen en AI-agents. Als AI & Automation Intern ondersteun je de ontwikkeling van tools die de efficiëntie binnen het bedrijf verbeteren, van workflows in Power Automate tot AI-agents gebouwd in Microsoft Foundry en script-gebaseerde oplossingen. Deze helpen medewerkers om informatie te raadplegen, content te genereren, documenten te verwerken en repetitieve taken efficiënter uit te voeren. Je werkt nauw samen met teams zoals Finance, HR, Operations, Partnerships, Marketing en Ticketing om hun dagelijkse processen te begrijpen en te bepalen waar automatisering echte waarde kan toevoegen. Een belangrijk onderdeel van de functie is goed begrijpen hoe elke afdeling werkt. Dat betekent de juiste vragen stellen, assertief zijn in het verzamelen van de informatie die je nodig hebt, en gedurende elk project duidelijk blijven communiceren met stakeholders. Deze rol is geschikt voor iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar bedrijfsprocessen, zelfverzekerd communiceert met verschillende stakeholders, en gedreven is om eigenaarschap te nemen van idee tot implementatie. De functie combineert technische interesse met sterke projectmanagementvaardigheden: je verzamelt relevante informatie, structureert workflows, bouwt oplossingen, test de resultaten, verbetert deze op basis van feedback, en traint eindgebruikers zodat de automatiseringen en agents goed worden geadopteerd zodra ze live staan. Jouw profiel Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding (bijv. bedrijfskunde, informatica, information management, AI of een vergelijkbare richting) en bent beschikbaar voor een meewerkstage. Je hebt technische affiniteit en leert snel nieuwe tools. Ervaring met Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry of scripten (bijv. Python) is een pré, maar belangrijker is dat je gemotiveerd bent om je hierin te verdiepen. Je denkt gestructureerd en projectmatig: je kunt een vraagstuk opknippen, workflows in kaart brengen en prioriteiten stellen. Je communiceert helder en zelfverzekerd, zowel in het ophalen van behoeften als in het meenemen en trainen van gebruikers. Naast Nederlands beheers je ook de Engelse taal. Mooi meegenomen als je zelf ook een passie hebt voor sport, dat hebben wij namelijk ook! Waar kom je terecht? description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France. About the role Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France. At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world. We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value. You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions. You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility. This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world. What we think you need to be successful Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL) Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…) Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. Interview process Initial interview Take-home exercise Final interview (in-person) Offer, references, and welcome to the team! Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Account Manager - EMEA
description: An Introduction to Primer Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform. Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on. Watch our showcase > Read up on our $100m Series C Learn more about our culture > 🔍 What will you be doing? Payment performance & risk mitigation Proactively monitor merchant integration and payment performance (authorisation rates, network tokenisation coverage, routing configuration) and flag risk before it becomes a problem. Recommend and drive routing/NT/config changes, making the economic case (auth rate, cost) for why they matter. Integration debugging Root-cause complex technical issues hands-on, failures, SDK conflicts, webhook gaps, using logs, traces and API behaviour. Loop in Primer engineering only when genuinely needed, rather than as a first resort. Technical escalation ownership You will act as an escalated contact during incidents that affect key merchants and require support from someone who has context on their particular payment stack. This sort of activity will be done in close contact with Support. During and after incidents, you will be in touch with key merchants to deliver RCA’s, walk-through any impacts and offer recommendations to prevent future exposure. Enablement & solution design Lead technical deep-dives and solution design sessions when a merchant adopts a new PSP connector, payment method, or unreleased Primer product as a design partner. Manage the expectation gap through rollout and feed structured, usable feedback back to Product and Engineering. Proactive technical reviews Run recurring technical integration reviews (e.g. quarterly) with each merchant's engineering/payments stakeholders, covering integration health, optimisation opportunities, and risk, independently of any commercial QBR run in-partnership with the AM. Regulatory & compliance navigation Translate changes in card scheme rules or regional regulation (e.g. BNPL rules, PCI requirements) into a concrete technical plan for each affected merchant. 👀 What we’d love to see: Deep, hands-on technical ability: comfortable reading API logs and traces, debugging integration issues directly, and writing basic scripts/SQL to investigate an issue — a real technical peer to a merchant's engineers, not a relationship manager with technical vocabulary. Experience in a technical, merchant/customer-facing role: Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Support Engineer, Customer Success Manager (technical focused), Implementation Specialist, in payments, fintech, or e-commerce. Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, and SDKs: The ability to explain technical flows clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. A proactive operating style: Comfortable identifying and surfacing risk before being asked, not just responding to tickets. Confidence and credibility presenting technical material: Comfortable presenting to senior technical stakeholders (VP Engineering, Head of Payments) at enterprise merchants. Comfortable owning ambiguity: Coordinating across Primer's engineering, product, and support teams without heavy oversight. Direct experience with payments infrastructure: network tokenisation, PSP connectors/routing, or card scheme mechanics. Design-partner support experience: exposure to beta or early-access product rollouts across key merchants. What this role is explicitly not Not a renewals or commercial negotiation owner, that's the Account Manager. Not a support/ticket-routing role, the bar is proactive technical ownership, not reactive Q&A. ✅ A typical interview process An initial intro call with a Talent Partner An interview with the Hiring Manager Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role A final, values-alignment interview What's the culture like at Primer? We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants. We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities. The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. title: Peer Review Operations Specialist - 2 Year FTC
description:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 2 Year FTC.

Role Summary

As a Peer Review Operations Specialist, you are a confident and highly organized self-starter, motivated by a culture of continuous improvement. You’re an excellent communicator and a natural team player, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and hold yourself accountable for meeting competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

Reporting to the Peer Review Operations Manager, you work as a member of the Peer Review Operations team to maintain efficient peer review workflows, ensure high vendor performance standards, and uphold excellent contributor experience for authors, editors, and reviewers. You will enforce turnaround time benchmarks for all peer review milestones to protect process integrity and ensure timeliness and quality of publication. You will have high standards of professional conduct in the workplace, and enjoy working with international colleagues from a range of cultures and settings. You will seek out opportunities for continuous quality improvement in department activities and be an effective champion of the PLOS vision, mission, and brand.

Responsibilities

Submission Management 

  • Ensure the timely, efficient peer review of all submissions
  • Ensure that queries or concerns escalated by vendors, Customer Care or other PLOS colleagues are addressed and resolved professionally and within required timelines, or escalated appropriately
  • Identify and remove barriers to submission, working collaboratively with colleagues across PLOS as required
  • Proactively identify workflow inefficiencies, variations or backlogs to diagnose persistent issues 
  • Ensure that manuscripts meet requirements and follow current policies and procedures

Workflows 

  • Troubleshoot persistent manuscript, workflow or system issues, providing expertise and advice, and exercising judgement to resolve the issue or escalate to the Peer Review Operations Manager or other colleagues as appropriate
  • Proactively raise data-driven recommendations for continuous journal operations and workflow improvements to the Peer Review Operations Manager
  • Ensure standard journal workflows are maintained as established, implementing and adopting process updates when approved by the Peer Review Operations Manager

Projects 

  • Contribute to workflow project and initiate proposals as requested, and undertake operations projects and initiatives as directed by the Peer Review Operations Manager
  • Serve as daily liaison with vendor representatives, monitoring quality and timeliness performance against target thresholds and KPIs

Other 

  • Contribute to other operational research outputs related to PLOS’s mission where required, so that our journal workflows are optimised to encourage scientific openness and transparency

Knowledge and Skills

Essential

  • Prior experience in peer-reviewed schololarly publishing
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral
  • Growth mindset with a collaborative, team player mentality
  • An ability to maintain a positive and professional customer service attitude
  • Able to work constructively with vendors, authors, editors, customers, and colleagues from a range of international settings
  • Knowledge of Excel, Word, file types and file conversions
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy
  • Able to set priorities and work independently
  • Upholds high standards of professionalism in the workplace
  • Embraces change with a positive attitude
  • An interest in science and in advancing scientific knowledge

Desirable

  • Knowledge of and expertise with peer review and manuscript management database systems; proficiency with Editorial Manager a plus
  • Knowledge of customer relationship management (CRM) software such as Salesforce
  • Awareness of and commitment to open science

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Some domestic and international travel required.

Qualifications

  • A university degree or equivalent experience 

 

The base salary range we've established for these positions is £27,000- £30,000. PLOS also offers a comprehenseive benefits package sumarized below.

BENEFITS: 

US:

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office 

 

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all.

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.

 What we can offer You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business. title: Solutions Delivery Manager
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW The Solutions Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring Benchling solution development, coverage, efficacy, quality, and enablement across the Customer Experience team. Operating at the intersection of our product suite and our customers, this dynamic role focuses on translating our product capabilities into effective solutions to match our customers' scientific use cases, and enabling the broader CX organization to operationalize around Benchling's best practices. Solutions Delivery Manager works cross-functionally with Benchling's build organization, as well as across the CX departments, to develop robust solutions that can deliver value to our customers, while improving internal knowledge and productivity. Chemistry is one of Benchling's newest and most exciting product areas — unlocking an entirely new group of companies, scientists, and science to be done on Benchling. This role will help navigate a budding product area through to market adoption, partnering closely with internal product, enablement, and delivery teams, while working directly with customers to build trust and help shape our vision in this space. Successful Solutions Delivery Managers will harness the knowledge and experience Benchling has gained across thousands of customer engagements, and leverage previous and learned experience to serve as an expert across scientific domains and modalities served by Benchling. They will develop, and continuously improve our solutions as both the science and Benchling product capabilities evolve. A successful candidate will be comfortable working across teams and systems, often with no existing guidance or playbook, to deliver impactful solutions and value aligned with our department and team goals. About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. 

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. 

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.  

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.


About the role
 
The Group Copy Supervisor plays an integral role in driving the creative development of high-quality copy and content for Avalere Health and one or more of our great clients. You will partner with other members of the creative team to develop copy and content, working closely with strategy, medical, client services, and other members of the team in these efforts. You will work together with the broader team to not only ensure our clients’ needs are met, but to strive to surpass their expectations.
 
Note: a portfolio featuring your pharma agency work must be submitted along with your resume.
 What we can offer You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August. Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business. We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Veeva Systems, a leader in cloud-based solutions for the global life sciences industry, is looking for a Project Management Consultant to join our Clinical Data Professional Services team. title: In Vivo Research Associate II, Konermann Lab
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

We are seeking an In Vivo Research Associate II to join the Konermann Laboratory at the Arc Institute.You will collaborate closely with experienced scientists to advance in vivo projects focused on understanding brain development.

This project builds on previous work in genome-scale CRISPR screening (Konermann et al., 2015; Biering et al., 2021; Wei et al., 2023; Roohani et al., 2025) and aims to combine modern functional genomics and neuroscience tools to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying brain development and function. The ideal candidate will have experience in animal handling and colony management, intracerebral injections, sample processing for single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial pipelines, and imaging. This position offers an excellent opportunity for candidates considering PhD programs, as it involves participation in all stages of a research project under the guidance of an experienced scientist.

About You

  • You love science and learning. Whether it's a new field or a new bench technique, you stay curious and enjoy stepping outside your comfort zone.
  • You are detail-oriented. You're careful and diligent about documentation and good lab practice, and you like keeping things organized.
  • You collaborate and help others. Science is a team effort, and you take the initiative to pitch in.
  • You are a problem solver. Experiments rarely work the first time. You bring patience and confidence to complex technical troubleshooting.

 In this position, you will

  • Plan, execute, analyze, and troubleshoot experiments with a high degree of independence, with continued support from the rest of the team
  • Perform in vivo mouse experiments, including stereotaxic surgeries, as well as IV and IP injections
  • Collect and process tissue, including vibratome and/or cryostat sectioning, immunostaining, and imaging
  • Comply with federal, Arc, and local IACUC/AAALAC regulations governing animal research
  • Follow Arc's standards for code of conduct, safety, and the handling of hazardous materials, biological materials, and controlled substances
  • Analyze and present data at subgroup meetings and seminars
  • Maintain an organized, detailed lab notebook

Job Requirements

  • BS with 2+ years of relevant experience, or MS, in molecular biology, neuroscience, or another relevant field. Relevant experience includes independent lab work during undergraduate studies
  • Strong experience working with laboratory animals, including handling, restraint, and procedures under an approved protocol (intracranial, IV, and IP injections, as well as perfusions)
  • Detail-oriented, with excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Outstanding critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Highly motivated and curious, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team
  • Ability to work some weekends as needed (days off can be swapped for weekdays

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience with cloning via Gibson assembly or Golden Gate protocols (library cloning experience is a plus)
  • Knowledge of and experience with NGS library preparation, particularly single-cell and spatial workflows
  • Computational skills (Python or R)

The base salary for this position is $75,900. This amount does not include benefits or other forms of compensation.

title: Clinical Laboratory Scientist II
description:
Location: On-Site in Boulder, CO (Foresight Dx business unit, a Natera company)

Shift: Tuesday - Saturday, 11:30am-8:00pm

About our Company:

Foresight Diagnostics is a molecular diagnostics company pioneering non-invasive cancer detection through highly sensitive, cell-free DNA-based liquid biopsy technologies. Our proprietary methods - originally developed at Stanford University - are designed to detect smaller tumors earlier and enable more personalized treatment strategies for patients with cancer. 

We sit at the intersection of molecular biology, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS), and we translate rigorous science into clinically meaningful solutions. Following our acquisition by Natera, we now combine the agility of a mission-driven startup with the scale and resources of a global leader in cell-free DNA testing. It’s an exciting moment to join us. 

Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, our team operates in a high accountability, collaborative environment where quality and continuous improvement aren’t just values - they’re how we work every day.

About the Role

The Clinical Laboratory Scientist II will be responsible for performing a variety of laboratory procedures involved in end-to-end processing of biological samples to enable successful downstream next-generation sequencing (NGS). Processing will include accessioning and both manual and automated extraction, library preparation, hybrid capture, sequencing and QC steps. Under the guidance of the Director of Clinical Laboratory Operations and the Laboratory Director, you will work collaboratively within the clinical laboratory leveraging your technical knowledge, skills and abilities to ensure efficient and quality results are provided to our clients and patients while also informing/participating in process improvements. This position will report to the Lab Manager.

 

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in chemical, physical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology from an accredited institution

    • Education received at a college or university located outside of the United States or United States Territories requires a credentials equivalency evaluation by an approved agency

  • Hold a current and active American Society of Clinical Pathology (ASCP) board certification

  • Hold current and valid Clinical Laboratory Scientist licensure (Generalist or CGMBS)

  • Demonstrate a working knowledge of the general biological principles that govern DNA biology

  • Possess a strong foundational understanding of common molecular biology techniques, such as PCR/qPCR, DNA ligation, and DNA extraction

  • Working level knowledge or ability to learn use of common molecular biology instruments; Agilent Tapestation/capillary electrophoresis, Qubit, plate readers, thermocyclers and other common laboratory instruments

  • Previous experience handling human biological materials is required

  • Working knowledge of how to safely operate in a BSL-2 environment is required

  • Previous experience handling, processing, and extracting DNA from biological specimens is required

 

What You Will Do

Technical

  • Perform routine and complex diagnostic laboratory testing on patient samples for clinical, biopharma, and academic partnerships.

  • Provide technical guidance and oversight to non-licensed personnel for pre-analytical, analytical and post-analytical activities.

  • Interpret data and results of all analyses according to set procedures and guidelines.

  • Support day to day operations by assisting with data entry, receiving samples and consumables, reagent preparation, sample preparation, temperature recording, laboratory maintenance and documentation.

  • Identify and resolve problems that may adversely affect test performance or reporting of test results following the escalation path to clinical leadership as needed.

  • Assist with research, translational research, regulated products through the execution of partnership studies and internal/external validation studies.

  • Participate as a contributing member of the clinical laboratory by assisting in routine activities, to include but not limited to general upkeep and stocking, SOP author and review, and continuous improvement.

  • Proposes assay and process improvements and conducts improvement activities under guidance.

  • Demonstrate forward thinking and initiative in work planning and execution of work in order to achieve on-time report delivery.

  • Participate in new or revised assay launches giving input on launch logistics as appropriate.

  • Participate in work planning initiatives and scheduling.

Quality, Training & Equipment

  • Maintaining documentation in compliance with Good Laboratory Practices and Quality Systems.

  • Assist with quality control and quality assurance activities. Responsible for reviewing and analyzing the health of laboratory quality metrics in collaboration with clinical leadership.

  • Complete initial training and maintain competencies as current and up to date for all trained assays.

  • Wear appropriate PPE as required and comply with safety rules and regulations.

  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOP).

  • Participate in IQ/OQ/PQ for equipment to ensure ability to train team members on proper use and maintenance as appropriate.

  • Escalate equipment issues that impact TAT or patient safety.

  • Assist, perform, and review instrument correlation studies. Collaborate with operational leadership on equipment analysis for assay expansion or improvement.

  • Perform instrument and procedural calibrations and maintenance.

  • Advises and drives progress on troubleshooting equipment issues.

  • Adhere to the laboratory's quality control policies including document control activities, change management, corrective preventative action.

  • May act as trainer in place of designated trainer/training team.

Team

  • Cultivate, build and maintain positive and collaborative relationships within teams and cross-functionally.

  • Operate as a thought leader and hold cross-functional teams accountable to regulatory, quality, scientific and performance standards to ensure the highest quality for sample integrity.

  • Seen as a role model for safety behavior standards and cultural tenets.

  • Serves as a leader from the bench, demonstrating consistency in good lab practices.

 

Working Conditions and Physical Effort

Staff in this role must be able to perform the essential functions of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation. Certain physical activities may be required in order to perform the essential functions of this job. Examples of these requirements include but are not limited to the following:

 

 

Compensation & Total Rewards 

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Annual performance incentive bonus
  • Long-term equity awards
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Generous paid time off and company holidays
  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. title: Scientist II, Screening
description:
Profluent is the frontier AI lab for biology. Profluent builds powerful foundation models for all of life's molecules, unlocking solutions that transform medicine, agriculture, and beyond. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Emeryville, CA, Profluent is backed by leading investors including Altimeter Capital, Bezos Expeditions, Spark Capital, Insight Partners, Air Street Capital, AIX Ventures, and Convergent Ventures and has raised over $150M to date.

The Role

Profluent is seeking a motivated, rigorous, and collaborative scientist to establish and lead a centralized gene editor screening function. High-quality experimental data is a core input to our protein design models, and this role will own the screening operations that produce it.

This role centers on building and running a screening core responsible for assay standardization, data quality, and team development. At first, you will support campaigns that generate training and evaluation data for our protein design models, and the scope may grow to cover more programs. You will design, run, and troubleshoot mammalian genome editing assays with NGS readouts in arrayed and pooled formats. You will set the technical standards that make our data reproducible and trustworthy. You will also build and mentor a team of Research Associates, and coordinate closely with Automation, Bioinformatics, Data Science, and Biology to keep the screening pipeline running smoothly from start to finish.

As a leader of the team, you will balance hands-on scientific execution with people management and process development. You will identify, prioritize, and drive infrastructure projects that improve throughput, consistency, and assay sensitivity. You will also work with leadership to shape the long-term scope of the core.

We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who share our commitment to revolutionizing biology, driving meaningful innovation, and making a lasting impact on global healthcare.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven protein design while collaborating with a dynamic, interdisciplinary team of experts in machine learning, protein engineering, cell biology, and gene editing.

 

Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a team of 2–4 Research Associates, including hiring, training, performance management, and career development
  • Train and mentor staff on aseptic technique, assay execution, and documentation standards
  • Foster a supportive team culture that prioritizes growth, engagement, and well-being

Execution

  • Prioritize, schedule, and resource cross-functional experiments in coordination with Automation and Bioinformatics
  • Design, execute, troubleshoot, and analyze mammalian genome editing assays with NGS readouts in arrayed and pooled formats
  • Onboard new assays and extend existing assays to new enzyme classes
  • Maintain sample chain of custody from plate mapping through automation, sample preparation, and sequencing submission, partnering with Bioinformatics on data schema and capture
  • Communicate technical results clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences
  • Deliver QC'd, analysis-ready datasets with documented QC flags to ML

Process Development

  • Define and enforce technical standards, and write and maintain SOPs
  • Qualify new assays and define acceptance criteria based on reproducibility data
  • Maintain cell line quality and inventory for screening assays, in coordination with teams that manage cell banks
  • Characterize assay sensitivity, including the minimum detectable difference in activity at standard replicate counts
  • Identify, prioritize, and plan infrastructure projects that continually improve assays and processes
  • Coordinate process development across Automation, Bioinformatics, Data Science, and Biology
  • Evaluate the costs and benefits of centralizing high-throughput workflows in partnership with other teams
  • Work with leadership to assess and refine the scope of core functions

 

Qualifications

  • PhD in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, or a related field and 2+ years of relevant industry experience, or MS in a related field and 10+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Hands-on experience with bacterial and mammalian cell culture, genome editing, and NGS-based assays
  • Experience with high-throughput experimentation and analysis of large datasets
  • Experience with LIMS or ELN systems for sample and experiment tracking
  • Demonstrated ability to establish technical standards and drive consistent execution across operators


Preferences

  • Experience working in or building a core facility or centralized service function
  • Track record of building or improving high-throughput processes
  • Experience leading infrastructure or process improvement projects
  • Experience with liquid handling automation and tech transfer
  • Experience with cell bank and inventory management
  • Strong foundation in experimental design and statistics, including power analysis and design of experiments (DOE)

$144,000—$160,000 USD

description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role You'll build out the data science layer of Adaptyv's foundry — the work that turns tens of thousands of raw, messy experimental readouts into clean, trustworthy, structured data that our customers, our models, and our own scientists can rely on. Binding (BLI/SPR), developability, biophysical, and functional assays all produce data at scale; your job is to make that data correct, comparable, and useful. This sits at the intersection of three things: data quality (is this number real, or an artifact?), bioinformatics (linking experimental results back to sequence, structure, and protein design), and dataset building (turning foundry output into the kind of high-quality, benchmarkable data that frontier AI labs actually want). You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the lab scientists who run the assays, the software team who own the pipelines, and the customers who train models on what we produce. This is a hands-on build role, not a management one. What You'll Do Own the scientific logic of data quality across the foundry: define what "good data" looks like for each assay type — expected signal ranges, control thresholds, failure modes, edge cases — and turn it into automated checks. Build anomaly detection and QC models that catch bad data the eye would miss: assay drift, instrument variability, plate effects, false passes and false fails — and distinguish real signal from noise statistically. Work with the software and ML teams to specify, review, and improve the automated data pipelines that process instrument outputs, feeding back precise requirements for what to flag, auto-reject, or route to human review. Connect experimental results back to the protein side — sequence, structure, and design — so wet-lab data and computational models reinforce each other. Turn foundry output into structured, documented, benchmark-grade datasets that are a genuine asset for our customers and for training and evaluating protein-design models. Apply real statistical rigor to multi-condition data at scale — thousands of samples across hundreds of simultaneous experiments — and make the results interpretable and comparable across runs. What We're Looking For Strong data science / bioinformatics background — you're fluent in Python (pandas, numpy, the scientific stack) and comfortable owning messy, real-world experimental data end to end. Genuine biology grounding — you understand proteins, assays, and sequence/structure/function well enough to know what the data means, not just how to process it. You don't need to be a bench scientist, but you can't be biology-blind. Statistical maturity — process control, anomaly detection, handling variability and batch effects; you can tell drift from noise and defend the call. Prolific builder with the receipts to prove it. You've shipped a lot — pipelines, tools, models, datasets — and can point to concrete things you built end to end and put into real use, not prototypes that died in a notebook. You move fast, systematize what works, and have no patience for babysitting a fixed dashboard. AI-native builder. It's 2026 — you build with coding agents like Claude Code as a default, and you have sharp judgment about what they produce. Interdisciplinary by instinct. You're energized working across the lab bench, software, and ML, and you treat automation and data infrastructure as part of your job. Bonus: experience with protein/sequence-structure data (bioinformatics tooling, structural data), ML on experimental data, or building datasets for model training and benchmarking.     • Ensure proper storage conditions (e.g., temperature, humidity) for various types of biological samples, including cryopreservation and ambient storage.

  • Research Support:
    • Assist in the design and execution of research projects involving the biorepository’s sample collection and management processes.
    • Contribute to scientific publications, presentations, and other research outputs, providing data and insights from biorepository-managed samples.
  • Continuous Improvement and Training:
    • Proactively identify areas for process improvement in sample management and recommend strategies to enhance operational efficiency.

    • Mentor and train junior staff or technicians on best practices in sample handling and database management.

description:
Data Analyst, Supply

                    

  Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditised, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

 

The role

As Prolific scales, maintaining a healthy and sustainable participant marketplace will be critical to our ability to meet growing demand for high-quality human data. This role will own analytics across the participant lifecycle, from acquisition and onboarding through activation, engagement, quality, retention, and reactivation.

You’ll build the metrics, dashboards, and experimentation frameworks that help us understand participant behaviour and improve the participant experience. You’ll work closely with Product, Operations, Growth, and Data Science to identify opportunities, structure experiments, and turn complex marketplace data into clear decisions.

Working hands-on across SQL, Python, experimentation, and stakeholder conversations, you’ll create clarity around participant health, marketplace liquidity, and long-term supply sustainability.

 

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Analytics Expertise: Advanced SQL and strong Python proficiency (e.g. pandas, experimentation analysis, automation), with a track record of building scalable reporting frameworks in modern BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Tableau). Comfortable owning problems end-to-end — from raw data to executive-ready insight.
  • Lifecycle Analytics: Experience analysing user acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, churn, and behavioural cohorts.
  • Experimentation & Statistics: Experience designing and analysing A/B or operational experiments, with solid grounding in statistical concepts and causal thinking.
  • Product Thinking: Ability to translate participant and marketplace challenges into measurable hypotheses, success metrics, and actionable recommendations.
  • Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to connect operational metrics to revenue, margin, and financial performance — understanding not just what is happening, but why it matters commercially.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment, setting priorities, challenging assumptions, and driving initiatives from problem definition through implementation.
