title: Scientist I, Synthetic Biology
description:
The Role: 

Generate’s Prototyping Lab builds the experimental systems that let us measure protein function at unprecedented scale. By combining synthetic biology, large DNA libraries, high-throughput assays, and machine learning, the team creates workflows that turn complex biological questions into rich, usable datasets. 

We’re looking for two Scientists with a strong record in experimental synthetic biology to develop pooled screens capable of testing hundreds of thousands of protein variants in parallel to identify protein binders and modulators. You’ll shape these experiments via DNA library design, pooled in vitro protein display, and NGS-based enrichment analysis. For one of the two roles, we are looking for a Scientist who additionally has experience in mammalian cell engineering and membrane protein studies. Experience in computational modeling or statistical analysis would help you connect experimental design to the quality and usefulness of the resulting data. 

You’ll work closely with Protein Sciences and Machine Learning teams to build screening approaches that deliver clear, quantitative insight into protein function. The role offers substantial scope to originate and advance new technologies, with close collaboration across a well-resourced biotech team.

Here's how you will contribute:

  • Build pooled screening workflows to achieve scalable protein binding and functional readouts, from assay setup through data interpretation.
  • Collaboratively establish reliable assay conditions, quantitative measures, and handoff plans that enable project teams to maximize platform utility.
  • Identify opportunities to test unconventional hypotheses, applying the strongest concepts for drug program acceleration and supporting IP filings.  
  • Synthesize findings into clear recommendations, and present them in presentations and in writing to colleagues across disciplines.
  • Use quantitative reasoning, modeling, and critical literature review to inform experimental choices. 

The Ideal Candidate will have:

  • PhD in synthetic or systems biology, bioengineering or a related field with 0-1 year of experience; alternatively, a bachelor’s or master’s degree with at least 6 years of highly relevant experience.
  • Hands-on experience designing and running pooled binding screens, ideally using both purified proteins and cell-based assays.
  • For one of the roles, we are seeking strong cell-culture skills, including experience engineering cell lines for screening applications using methods such as CRISPR, lentiviral transduction, or transposon-based integration; experience working with membrane proteins is also highly preferred.  
  • Experience designing and building pooled DNA libraries, and using next-generation sequencing to track enrichment in selection campaigns.
  • Familiarity with recombinant protein production, purification, and/or binding assays is an advantage.
  • Ability to interpret complex screening data and write scripts in Python or a similar language; familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor or other LLM-based platforms.

  • High level of cross-functional autonomy and self-motivation. 

Who will love this job: 

  • Biologists who integrate computational insight with experimentation to tackle complex problems.
  • Experimentalists who enjoy making difficult targets, including membrane proteins, tractable for pooled binding screens.
  • Platform builders who value assay robustness, data quality, and interpretable results alongside throughput.

title: Candidate Experience Coordinator, Cambridge, MA
description:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.

The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 

Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.

The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you. 

 

About Iso

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.

Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.

Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

 

Your impact 

As a Candidate Experience Coordinator, you are the engine of our Talent Acquisition (TA) function. You won’t just support recruitment; you will architect, own, and lead the candidate journey through interdisciplinary collaboration.

Overseeing complex global scheduling, you will own the holistic end-to-end candidate experience— running an efficient and exceptional interview process from the first touchpoint to the final stages. You will drive data integrity to influence hiring decisions, whilst also serving as a process engineer who identifies bottlenecks and implements smoother workflows. This position is designed as a launchpad for your career, giving you interdisciplinary visibility and significant project ownership across the talent acquisition lifecycle.

What you will do 

1. Own the Candidate Experience Architecture

  • Curate the Journey: Act as a primary, consistent point of contact for candidates, ensuring every interaction is timely, seamless, and supportive. You will seamlessly balance high volume scheduling with candidate care.
  • Host the Onsite Experience: Act as the host and central lead for our onsite (or virtual) interview days, ensuring candidates feel welcomed, prepared, and impressed.
  • Humanise Communication: Partner across the team to design candidate communications. You will ensure our templates are authentic and aligned with our values, including managing early-stage rejections with empathy and professionalism.
  • Scheduling Excellence: Orchestrate complex, interdisciplinary interview loops across multiple time zones with speed and efficiency, proactively managing any last-minute changes with candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers.

2. Drive Operational Excellence & Data Integrity

  • Be a "Data Guardian”: Champion the quality and consistency of our data within our ATS (Greenhouse). You will manage job set up, build interview processes and ensure  candidate statuses are meticulously maintained to enable accurate reporting.

Onboarding Operations: Oversee critical onboarding and compliance operations, such as right-to-work checks, pobu (integrating people data with relevant google systems), and background checks. Upskill and educate the talent team on criticality of accurate data and Greenhouse (ATS) best practices in both hiring and onboarding processes.

  • Feedback Loops: Partner with the Principal Talent Lead to analyse candidate survey data. You will turn these insights into meaningful actions, blending data-driven and experiential perspectives to continuously elevate our standards.
  • Identify & Eradicate Bottlenecks: Proactively flag recurring scheduling challenges or process delays. You won’t just follow the process; you will help evolve it by suggesting improvements and piloting new workflows.

3. Enablement & Strategic Partnership

  • Scaling processes: Utilising AI, you will assist in documenting core processes for TA, creating clear and consistent guides for everything from complex scheduling to offer approval workflows. Additionally, you will ensure effective training for any new coordinators and wider TA members.
  • Champion Interdisciplinary Partnership: You will have opportunities for domain alignment with specific verticals, allowing you to build deeper context on the roles you support and partner closely with Hiring Managers, thereby leveraging diverse skills and perspectives across the business.

Skills and qualifications 

Essential:

  • Exceptional Organisation: Ability to prioritise multiple functions and tasks while maintaining the highest attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience Centric: A strong focus on providing the best possible candidate experience, with the empathy to manage relationships through the entire recruitment lifecycle.
  • Tech & Data Savvy: Experience using online calendar/meeting applications (G-Suite preferred) and a data-driven approach with a strong desire to advocate for clean data.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills, capable of keeping stakeholders updated and writing "human-first" correspondence.
  • Global Mindset: Experience scheduling and complex coordination across multiple time zones.

description:
Who we are

CreateFuture is fast becoming the UK’s most recognisable digital consultancy, with years of experience building digital products and services for major organisations whilst putting our people first. We have offices in the centre of Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, and London as well as remote employees located throughout the country.

Our reputation as a partner determined to deliver high-quality, robust and thoughtful products has enabled us to scale to over 500 people in the last couple of years, and it is our amazing people - along with the safe, supportive and friendly culture we have built - that makes CreateFuture a great place to work. Don’t just take our word for it though, we have been recognised by Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row - across a number of categories - and our employee exit rate is astonishingly low. 

Join us on our journey… Let’s create something awesome, together, today.

 

About the role and team:

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You will be embedded in a team delivering for a client in a fast-paced, product-led environment, and you will be accountable for how your workstream is delivered, not just the code you write. You lead from the front: still close enough to the technology to make the call, and senior enough to own the outcome. You set the technical direction, keep the delivery signal honest, and grow the engineers around you. We work at pace. Priorities move, requirements are rarely perfect on day one, and we value people who can bring order to ambiguity rather than wait for it to clear.

How we work with AI:

AI-assisted development is core to how we build, not a side experiment. We use modern AI coding agents to remove the drudgery so engineers can focus on the high-value decisions: architecture, trade-offs, and getting the right thing built. Humans own every change, and quality is held by review and ownership, not by the tool. As a Tech Lead you will help raise the quality and consistency of how the team uses AI: knowing the domain and the codebase well enough to steer the tools, avoid reinventing what already exists, and articulate intent clearly so the AI accelerates good engineering rather than multiplying mediocre code.

Our tech stack Core:

  Java (with Spring Boot) A roughly even split of RESTful Java APIs and Kafka / event-driven services CI/CD pipelines AWS (including S3, Lambda, ECS, EKS, MSK) Broader ecosystem you will get your hands on: Kubernetes and containerisation Infrastructure as code AI integrations and agentic development workflows Strong security practices across the stack Full DevOps ownership ("you build it, you run it")

You will not need all of this from day one, but these are the tools, systems and practices you will work with.

What you'll be doing:

Technical: Building Java services across REST APIs and Kafka / event-driven pipelines (roughly an even split), with a focus on readable, maintainable and well-tested code Writing tests as part of development (TDD approaches are encouraged) Integrating with third-party APIs (for example payment gateways and suppliers) Defining and overseeing technical implementations: shaping how things are built, not just writing code Championing AI-assisted ways of working and lifting the bar on quality, consistency and reuse across the team

Leading the workstream: Owning your workstream end to end: you can always answer what you own and who covers it when you are out, whether you are on track for the next milestone, what is blocked or at risk, and what decision is needed and who needs to know Driving the dates: actively managing delivery rather than passively reporting it, and spotting risk early enough to act before dates slip Getting ahead of the next thing: shaping and estimating upcoming work with product and delivery before it hits the team, so the team drives the work rather than inheriting it Communicating before you are chased, and working in the open (visible progress in shared channels, feedback captured where it belongs) Identifying and removing bottlenecks in delivery Handling difficult client conversations professionally when needed, with support from your colleagues Spotting knowledge gaps and offering mentoring, pairing and coaching to grow the engineers around you

 

We'd love to talk to you if:

  • You have strong Java and Spring Boot, across both REST APIs and event-driven / Kafka systems
  • You care about engineering quality: code reviews, automated tests, and maintainability
  • You lead in the open, share knowledge, and actively raise the bar for the team
  • You are comfortable driving delivery and, with support, handling client conversations
  • You embrace AI-assisted development: using modern AI tools to go faster while owning the quality and knowing when to trust them and when not to
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can bring structure to ambiguity
  • You are familiar with cloud services and CI/CD, or excited to learn more
  • You want to build more than boilerplate APIs: solving real problems, with proper ownership

 


What we'll offer you:

At CreateFuture, we challenge ourselves to go beyond the obvious and we care deeply about our craft and customer

title: Lab Technician, Lab Operations
description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role Our lab in Lausanne runs thousands of constructs a week through automated workcells, liquid handlers, and binding instruments. That only works if the instruments are calibrated, the buffers are made, the stock is where the system says it is, and the bench is ready when the scientists arrive. You are the person who makes sure it is. You'll own the day-to-day upkeep of our automation and instruments, run buffer and reagent production, keep the lab clean, safe, and stocked, and lead the rollout of new inventory management and lab operations processes across the lab. This is a hands-on, in-the-lab role, working closely with our Lab Manager, the Lab Operations team, and the scientists whose experiments depend on you getting it right. What You'll Do Run daily and weekly calibration of our Hamilton liquid handling systems. Calibrate and maintain key instruments, including the Echo and pH meters. Look after the SPR system: buffer bottle changes, rinsing, and routine upkeep. Take ownership of our automated workcells and keep them clean, organized, and calibrated. Prepare buffers, reagents, and reaction mixes according to established SOPs. Run weekly buffer production and handle ad-hoc requests from the team. Lead the rollout of new inventory management and lab operations processes across the lab, and help design and improve them as the lab scales. Organize fridges and storage, run inventory, and keep consumables, glassware, and bench supplies stocked so experiments never stall. Keep benches and shared spaces clean, clear, and ready for work every day. Manage hazardous and biohazardous waste disposal (including broken glass and sharps), waste sorting, recycling, and general waste removal in line with safety regulations. Run the lab dishwasher and make sure clean glassware is always available. Plan and document scheduled deep cleans and preventive maintenance. What We're Looking For Laboratory apprenticeship (CFC Laborant/in), BSc in biology, chemistry, or a relevant field, or an equivalent lab technician qualification. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Precision in following and executing protocols and SOPs. A service mindset. You enjoy making other people's work easier. Comfortable with routine, with an eye for ways to improve it. Calm and reliable in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment. Experience with lab automation or liquid handling systems (Hamilton, Echo, or similar) is a plus. Experience with inventory or LIMS tools is a plus. Proficiency in English and French is a plus. Many of our vendors and delivery services operate in French. title: Assistant Video Editor
description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

Vox Media is looking for an Assistant Video Editor to join a growing post-production team within the branded content division for Vox and New York Magazine. This role is built for an editor early in their career who is sharp with turnkey and templated formats, comfortable owning quick-turn social cuts independently, and eager to grow into larger, more complex projects under supervision. You'll also work closely with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external editors, making you a key connective piece between in-house editing and the freelance bench.

 

Editing and Craft

  • Edit turnkey and templated content such as cutdowns, recaps, and repeatable social formats for various platforms
  • Cut quick-turn social edits independently, following established templates and house style
  • Take on larger or more complex edits with guidance from the Post-Production Supervisor and Creative Directors, building toward independent ownership of bigger projects over time
  • Add basic music and sound design to elevate templated pieces
  • Apply light color and LUTs following house presets

Project Setup and Coordination

  • Partner with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external/freelance editors such as bins, sequences, and file structure, following in-house SOPs
  • Create stringouts for Editors and Creative Directors per project
  • Prep and organize incoming footage, dailies, and assets ahead of handoff to external editors
  • Support project wrap-out and archiving, keeping files clean and organized across both in-house and external-editor projects

 

Workflow and Technical

  • Work in Adobe Premiere, including Team Projects and Productions, following house SOPs for project, bin, sequence, and track structure
  • Support turnovers to color and sound mix during finishing on larger projects
  • Work flexibly across a remote and hybrid workflow, including shipping/receiving drives and cloud sync as needed

 

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Share cuts via Frame.io and address internal notes accurately, flagging concerns proactively
  • Maintain clear communication with producers, the Post-Production Supervisor, and external editors
  • Learn from and support senior editors on shared projects, with room to grow into more senior editing responsibility over time

WHO YOU ARE

  • 2-3 years of experience editing in a digital, social, or branded content environment
  • Comfortable and fast with templated, repeatable edit formats, with a desire to grow into more complex, independent work
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere; familiarity with team projects/Productions is a plus
  • Comprehensive knowledge of technical specifications for distribution across all digital platforms
  • Organized and detail-oriented - comfortable managing file structure and project setup, not just cutting
  • Familiarity with Frame.io or similar review/delivery tools

 

WHERE YOU'LL WORK

This role is based in our New York City office. You’ll work a hybrid schedule: in-office three days a week & remote two days a week.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.

Pay Range
$70,000—$80,000 USD

OUR DEI COMMITMENT

Vox Media is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can show up as their authentic selves and create their best work. We recognize that great stories, platforms, products and services come from people with all manner of backgrounds and experiences. We recognize that our commitments require ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices. 

Vox Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer and qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law. Vox Media will also consider all qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable Fair Chance laws. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations as part of the application process to candidates with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, please contact our recruiting team (recruitment@voxmedia.com).

WHAT COMES NEXT

Our recruiting team will go through applications in a timely manner. Please note that our recruiting team will only contact you from @voxmedia.com email addresses, never via text message. Read more about how our recruiting team operates, and how to protect yourself from recruitment fraud, here.

title: Youth Years Leader, Ashoka Global
description:
Ashoka has changed the framework of the social sector by introducing the idea that there is nothing more powerful than a bold, new idea in the hands of an exceptional entrepreneur. We build fellowships of people who catalyze an irreversible social change through an innovative idea and encourage others to do the same.
Role:
 
Ashoka is looking for a dynamic changemaker to take charge in transforming Ashoka's Youth Years programming.
 About Ashoka: Ashoka is the world’s largest community of leading social entrepreneurs, having pioneered the field of social entrepreneurship over 40 years ago. We support a robust network of more than 4,000 Ashoka Fellows in 90 countries who have successfully implemented systems-changing solutions to human and environmental problems globally. By learning from and collaborating with our Fellows and other social entrepreneurs, Ashoka identifies patterns and key levers to help society gain a new framework for living in the world as a changemaker. Our current work is centered around the "Everyone a Changemaker" (EACH) movement, which stems from our belief that everyone has the potential and responsibility to make positive change in an ever-changing world. We continue to grow a global movement of social entrepreneurship, recognizing that the rate of change is accelerating and our problems are growing faster than our solutions.

Client delivery

title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
description: Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading. About the Role We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast. Every bet runs through the same gates. You scale into owning the category, with supply, acquisition and ops building out under you. Think of this seat as a venture builder inside Fleek. One thing this is not. title: Junior Commercial Associate — Works in Progress
description:
Location: London, in office
Reports to: Head of Commercial and Audiovisual, Works in Progress
Salary: £30k-35k 

About Works in Progress

Works in Progress is Stripe’s magazine of new and underrated ideas to improve the world. We publish an eclectic mix of articles on policy, economics, business, technology, science, history, arts and culture.

Our audience is growing quickly and includes people making things happen, particularly in technology and politics. We are expanding the commercial side of the magazine—including advertising, subscriptions, events and partnerships—and are looking for an ambitious graduate to help us build it.

The role

This is an entry-level commercial role for a recent graduate who is ambitious, organised and excited to learn quickly in a small, entrepreneurial team.

You will work closely with the Director of Commercial and Audiovisual across the magazine’s commercial activity: advertising, subscriptions, events, marketing and partnerships. You will help keep commercial projects moving by conducting research, supporting outreach, maintaining pipelines and trackers, following up with prospective partners, and contributing to growth experiments.

You will learn by doing: writing outbound emails, building target lists, preparing materials, tracking results, joining calls and following up consistently. It is a strong opportunity for someone who wants early exposure to senior commercial work and meaningful responsibility from the start of their career.

What you’ll do

  • Support the advertising sales process, including preparing rate cards, pitch decks, outreach and pipeline materials.
  • Research and build target lists of potential advertisers, sponsors, agencies, founders, investors and partners.
  • Draft clear, thoughtful outbound emails and follow-ups.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, commercial trackers and reporting.
  • Support subscription growth through acquisition and retention ideas, and help measure their effectiveness.
  • Help develop the events business, including sponsor research, partnership outreach and event planning support.
  • Assist with early marketing and growth experiments across paid acquisition, referrals, partnerships, direct mail and audience development.
  • Prepare decks, reports and briefing materials that help commercial conversations move forward.
  • Join meetings and calls with clients, partners and agencies, taking notes and supporting follow-up.
  • Help turn commercial ideas into clear proposals with pricing, positioning and next steps.
  • Work across sales, marketing, events and subscriptions, adapting quickly as priorities evolve.
  • Take on the practical, sometimes unglamorous work needed to help a small business grow.

We’re looking for someone who

  • Is a recent graduate, or has equivalent early-career experience.
  • Is excited by commercial work and motivated by helping ideas turn into revenue.
  • Is interested in sales, marketing, partnerships, media, events or business development.
  • Is highly organised and comfortable managing lists, trackers and multiple follow-ups.
  • Is numerate and confident using spreadsheets.
  • Is a sharp, clear writer who can communicate professionally over email and in presentations.
  • Is proactive, resilient and comfortable reaching out to people they do not know.
  • Is curious, resourceful and willing to learn quickly.
  • Enjoys working in a small team where everyone pitches in.
  • Is comfortable with both high-profile opportunities and repetitive operational work, such as researching prospects and following up on outreach.

description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Veeva Ostro sits at the intersection of life sciences, marketing, and artificial intelligence. We empower pharmaceutical brands, healthcare providers (HCPs), and patients by orchestrating AI-enabled omnichannel engagement across the entire patient and prescriber lifecycle.
 
As the Data Analytics Lead, you will own the data systems and associated measurement analyses that sit at the intersection of our products, customers, and commercial strategy. Our products generate significant data as users ask questions and take action, and you will work with the product team to surface and execute on insights that govern how our product evolves. Our Business Consulting team is focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers. title: HR Generalist
description:
About Truveta

Truveta is on a mission to save lives with data. We are building the world's largest and most comprehensive health data platform to accelerate scientific discovery, improve patient care, and enable the next generation of AI-driven healthcare. Our India Development Center (IDC) plays a critical role in scaling our engineering, product, and business operations globally.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for an HR Generalist who is passionate about creating exceptional employee experiences and helping build a high-performing organization.

The Opportunity

As an HR Generalist, you will support the day-to-day People operations for our growing India Development Center and help manage the employee lifecycle from onboarding through offboarding. You will work closely with employees, managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure smooth HR operations and a positive employee experience. As the IDC continues to scale, you will also provide support for Talent Acquisition activities, including sourcing, interview coordination, candidate engagement, and hiring operations.

This is an opportunity to gain broad exposure across HR operations, employee engagement, Talent Acquisition, and other People initiatives while helping build and scale our People function in India.

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

  • Provide day-to-day HR support and guidance to employees and managers.
  • Manage employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, confirmations, promotions, internal transfers, documentation, and offboarding.
  • Deliver a smooth and engaging onboarding experience for new hires.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and ensure HR systems are updated in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate with Payroll, Finance, IT, and other teams to ensure seamless HR operations.
  • Support employee queries related to HR policies, processes, benefits, payroll, and other People matters.
  • Support compliance with company policies, Indian labor laws, and statutory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve HR processes.

Talent Acquisition Support

  • Support the Talent Acquisition function as hiring continues to scale in India.
  • Assist with sourcing and identifying candidates for open positions.
  • Coordinate interviews across candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels.
  • Manage candidate communication, scheduling, and interview follow-ups.
  • Maintain accurate candidate information and hiring status in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Support offer coordination, pre-joining engagement, and transition of candidates into onboarding.
  • Help maintain hiring trackers, reports, and recruitment dashboards.
  • Ensure candidates have a positive and well-coordinated experience throughout the hiring process.

Employee Engagement & People Initiatives

  • Support employee engagement, recognition, wellness, and culture-building programs.
  • Assist with employee communications and People-related events and initiatives.
  • Support HR projects and organizational initiatives as the India Development Center continues to grow.
  • Partner with the broader People team on programs that enhance the overall employee experience.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • MBA/PGDM in Human Resources is preferred.
  • 2–4 years of experience in an HR Generalist or HR Operations role.
  • Strong understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle.
  • Some exposure to Talent Acquisition, recruitment coordination, or candidate sourcing is preferred.
  • Experience working with HR systems and/or Applicant Tracking Systems.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and integrity.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and growing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a fast-growing technology or product organization.
  • Exposure to recruiting for technology or engineering roles.
  • Exposure to employee engagement, performance management, and HR analytics.
  • Working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory compliance.
  • Experience with platforms such as Greenhouse, Workday, BambooHR, or similar HR/ATS systems.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to work independently as the organization scales.

title: Growth Lead (Berlin)
description: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. At Almedia, you’ll: Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast. Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity. Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people. Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need. Growth Lead (Berlin) Salary: 100-120k We are looking for a powerhouse Growth Lead (Berlin) to become the a dedicated leader for our Growth (sales and account management) team. Reporting directly to the Growth Director and in close alignment with the CEO, you will be the architect of our go-to-market engine. This is a dual-impact role: you will lead, coach, and motivate a high-performing team while remaining "in the trenches" to close strategic partnerships with the world’s top mobile game publishers. You will own end-to-end growth by building a high-accountability team culture and a repeatable GTM playbook. You will turn publisher insights into product strategy, move fast to scale our outbound motion, and raise the bar on execution across the entire lifecycle—from first contact to long-term integration and partnership. What You’ll Do 🎯 Architect the GTM Playbook: Build and own a repeatable outbound sales motion. You’ll define our segmentation, messaging, and CRM workflows to ensure the team executes with speed and precision. Lead from the Front: Personally drive Tier-1 deals from discovery to signed integration. You will land key accounts that serve as the "win stories" to unlock the rest of the market. Scale & Mentor the Team: Manage, motivate, and develop a part of the Growth team. You’ll be responsible for their KPIs, career growth plans, and day-to-day coaching to foster a culture of extreme ownership. Bridge Product & Market: Create a tight feedback loop with Product and Engineering. You will translate publisher needs into a prioritized backlog, ensuring our roadmap is aligned with what the market actually buys. Operational Excellence: Define the rituals of success—qualification standards, pipeline hygiene, and forecasting. You will provide the Growth Director with a live, transparent view of deal health and unblock the team to keep opportunities moving. What your first 90 days look like Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on. Days 31–60: Take over a full book of accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement. Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book. Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Lead to Strategic Growth Lead with even more ownership, and beyond. What You’ll Bring 💡 The "Player-Coach" DNA: You have a proven track record of running full-cycle enterprise sales (prospect → pitch → close) while simultaneously managing a small team. Pipeline Mastery: You know how to build an outbound engine from scratch. You are comfortable experimenting with A/B outreach, sequencing, and offer tests to find what sticks. description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
The role of Patient Coordinator will be central to the success of the Signatera product line.  This position will be focused on growing the relationship between Natera and its patients to ensure timely management of testing.  Core responsibilities include collaborating with Nurse Coordinators to increase revenue and drive market development through direct sales by being the key contact for patient needs.  The Patient Coordinator will accomplish this by being the patient advocate within Natera.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Work with assigned Nurse Coordinator to maintain & support existing customers.
  • Assess the needs of patients with a focus on customer support, coordination of logistics, and problem solving.
  • Maintain and support a service-oriented relationship with patients
  • Ensure all data and analysis requests from different parts of the organization are addressed in a timely manner.
  • Help manage our business system tools (e.g. QlikView, Salesforce)
  • Identify, nurture and grow patient relationship in order to influence and schedule ongoing testing.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and have access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job.
  • Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.
  • Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum of 2 years of Call Center experience in an inbound and outbound capacity.
  • Minimum of 2 years of sales experience 
  • Background in medical or biological sciences preferred
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:
  • Outgoing personality with excellent oral & presentation skills.
  • Ability to think strategically as well as execute tactically
  • Emphasis on competitive analysis and team first attitude.
  • Ability to relate and educate our technology to potential patients
  • Strong quantitative and MS Excel skills
  • Self-motivation, with the desire and capacity to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Must act with a sense of urgency
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills (written and verbal)

 

 

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Events & Community Manager
description: About us: Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the role: Restaurant owners trust other restaurant owners. They listen to the chef down the street, their wine supplier and their accountant long before they listen to an ad. That's why our events work. When we launched in Berlin, we hosted a four-hands dinner with two local merchants and a well-known food creator. We believe that’s what builds credibility, trust, and ultimately a warm prospect list. We’re hiring an Events & Community Manager to turn that into a program that runs in several markets at the same time. You’ll plan and run our partner and owned events, and find new ways to grow Tebi through the hospitality community in each city, neighbourhood and market. You’ll work closely with our local sales teams so every event and partnership turns into real conversations. This is a hands-on role. One week you'll be hosting a merchant dinner in Milan, the next you'll be setting up a distributor breakfast in Amsterdam. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our Marketing team to extend these programs to our channel ecosystem, plus align closely with the General Managers and Account Managers in each market. What you'll be doing: Run events across markets: Plan and deliver partner and owned events in 2–3 markets at a time, from intimate merchant dinners and industry breakfasts to city launches. You own the calendar, budget, venues, suppliers, guest lists and the plan for the night. Build the playbook as you go: Turn each event into templates, checklists and supplier lists, so we can launch a city campaign in weeks, not months. Improve them after every event. Build local partner networks: Find the people operators already trust: drinks distributors, wholesalers, food creators, hospitality associations, accountants and the advisers who help new venues open. Build partnerships that bring us introductions and referrals, not just logos. Put our merchants front and center: Work with our best merchants as hosts and anchors, so prospects hear about Tebi from the people they respect. Turn connections into pipeline: Agree with local Sales and Account Management who to involve, how to follow up and who owns what conversations. Track every event in HubSpot from invite to demo to signed merchant. Grow Tebi through the community: Find new ways to reach operators through the people and places they already trust, in each city, neighborhood and across borders. Keep guests and partners engaged after events, so one introduction leads to the next. Open new community channels: Test new ways to grow through our close-knit industry, such as an affiliate or referral program for partners, sharing useful insights from our merchants, and showing up in the forums and groups where operators talk shop. Capture the stories: Work with our creative team and relevant freelancers to turn events and partner moments into social content, case studies and sales material. How we'll measure success: Events delivered each quarter across markets, on time and on budget Demos, pipeline and new merchants from each event and partnership Introductions, referrals and leads from partners, affiliates and community channels Cost per demo compared with our other channels What you’ll bring: Have built something people show up for: an event series, a supper club, a community, a program. You can point to what it led to, not just how many people came Feel at home in hospitality. You've worked in or around restaurants, bars or food and drink brands, and you're comfortable leading a room full of operators Are high agency. You own your calendar, your relationships and your results, and you don't wait to be told what to do Build your own playbook when there isn't one, and you enjoy doing the work as much as planning it Know the difference between a real community and a guest list See growth opportunities beyond events, and are curious enough to test them Can run several markets at once without dropping details, and are happy to travel regularly Track what you do: comfortable with a CRM (HubSpot a plus), UTMs and simple reporting Speak fluent English. Dutch, German, Italian, Spanish or a Nordic language is a plus Typically this means 3–5 years in events, community, field marketing or partnerships, but we care more about what you've built than how long you've been doing it. This role isn't for you if: You'd rather plan the program than run it You need a fixed playbook and a clear org chart to get going You're not willing to roll up your sleeves on the night Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary Lunch Provided in Office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improv

title: Solution Marketing Manager | Luma
description:
Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need

Scientists are solving some of the hardest problems in the world. Your job is to make sure they find the tools that help them do it. 

As a Solution Marketing Manager at Dotmatics, you'll work at the center of science and communication, deeply understanding how researchers in your application area think, what they're trying to accomplish, and what gets in their way. You'll translate that understanding into stories, campaigns, and content that connect scientists with the right solutions at the right moment. 

From a product perspective, Luma and ELN are your primary vehicles. Both require messaging that works at the enterprise level and resonates with specific scientific audiences. Dotmatics also has a broad portfolio of specialized products, each with their own dedicated marketers. Your job is not to own those products, but to connect them into compelling solution narratives when they're relevant to your audience and use case. 

We're looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how scientists work, who loves the challenge of making complex ideas land, and who finds real satisfaction in building something from the ground up. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk. 

In this role you will get to: 

  • Own the positioning, messaging, and content development for your scientific application area: personas, use cases, value propositions, differentiation, and collateral.
  • Develop strategic campaign briefs that translate positioning into actionable guidance for demand generation and integrated marketing.
  • Build and maintain sales enablement materials that help the Dotmatics commercial team have better conversations, including pitch frameworks, solution narratives, objection handling, and competitive context.
  • Partner with the wider marketing team to deliver the message to the market.
  • Engage directly with internal subject matter experts and customers to gather insights and shape strategy.
  • Act as the voice of your scientific audience across marketing and sales, influencing decisions and building alignment across senior stakeholders. 

We are looking for people who have 5+ years in a role where science and communication intersect: marketing, field applications, science communications, or similar, ideally in life sciences or research software. 

  • Scientific grounding to have credible conversations with researchers. A degree in a relevant discipline can be a real advantage here, and relevant hands-on experience is equally welcome.
  • A track record of taking something complicated and making it click for an audience who didn't have time to become an expert.
  • You've had the chance to build something from scratch before, and you want to do it again.
  • You're comfortable working across functions and influencing without direct authority. 

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. 

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

title: PLOS One Associate Editor - Life Sciences
description:
*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA.

 In the US, this is a union represented position as part of the Pacific Media Workers Guild, Local 39521 of the NewsGuild-Communication Workers of America. 

Role Summary 

PLOS is a nonprofit organization on a mission to drive open science forward with measurable, meaningful change in research publishing, policy, and practice. We believe in a better future where science is open to all, for all.  

 The Associate Editor oversees the editorial process for manuscripts submitted to PLOS journals. This role will require the use of prior research experience, critical evaluation skills, and internal guidelines to make nuanced and complex editorial decisions. The Associate Editor works with colleagues in their division and other teams to deliver developmental and promotional activities for PLOS journals. 

 

Responsibilities 

  • Serve as a point of escalation for complex and nuanced editorial queries. 
  • Support other teams at PLOS, members of the editorial board, and third-party editorial teams to ensure high standards of scientific rigor and editorial integrity are upheld. 
  • Evaluate submissions and make decisions based on reviewers’ comments. 
  • Participate in activities to develop editorial policy and improve the visibility and reputation of journals in the PLOS portfolio. 
  • Handle publication ethics queries. 
  • Build relationships with members of the academic community. 
  • Demonstrate a positive, constructive attitude to change and a growth mindset. 

 

Knowledge and Skills 

  • Experience in a research environment, publishing, or other relevant industry. 
  • Highly organized and efficient, with strong critical assessment, and problem-solving abilities. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral. 
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy. 
  • Able to set priorities and work independently. 

 

Qualifications 

  • A PhD is required. 

 

Physical Requirements and Work Environment 

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer 
  • Some national and international travel may be required occasionally 
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones 

 

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is (UK) £35,000 - £38,950 / (US) $67000 to $73,625. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below.  

 

BENEFITS: 

US:

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office 

UK: 

  • Private medical insurance 
  • Life assurance 
  • Income protection  
  • Personal accident insurance 
  • Pension with up to 10% employer match 
  • 25 days holidays, market competitive Maternity and Paternity leave 
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off 
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year 
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all. 

Visit plos.org/careers to learn more.

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

title: Research Scientist / Research Engineer, Automated Safety
description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

As scientific AI systems become more capable and autonomous, their safety assessment and safeguards must develop alongside them. At Lila Sciences, you will help build the research methods and tools that make this possible, so that more and more decision-enablers can be automated safely. This will move us closer to the vision of a safety and security apparatus that is robust to a fully autonomous scientific engine.

Your initial focus will be misuse: developing flexible and automated red-teaming approaches that test safety-relevant scientific capabilities and the robustness of safeguards. You will also contribute to safety automation beyond red teaming, helping the team evaluate, monitor and respond to risks across increasingly autonomous scientific workflows. You will own reusable research methods and assessment tools, working with mitigation engineers who implement protective mechanisms. We welcome Research Scientists and Research Engineers; responsibilities can span or evolve between the two profiles.

What You'll Be Building

  • Develop and run capability evaluations of scientific models, agents and tool-mediated workflows (including simulated lab environments), working with domain experts to make tests scientifically meaningful.
  • Create methods or systems that explore diverse failure modes, adapt tests as evidence emerges and support systematic investigation beyond fixed benchmarks.
  • Build reproducible experiments and evaluation tools that capture relevant behavior, outcomes and the evidence needed to interpret findings.
  • Measure the quality and coverage of automated assessments, including failure cases in the evaluators themselves.
  • Develop broader safety automation, across threat model management, evidence triage, regression testing, monitoring workflows or tools that help researchers assess and respond to risks.
  • Collaborate with risk researchers and mitigation engineers to translate findings into improved assessments and safeguards, and verify whether those changes work.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Strong empirical judgment, practical programming ability and experience working with modern AI systems.
  • The ability to investigate ambiguous failures, design informative comparisons and communicate limitations clearly.
  • An interest in scientific misuse risks and the ability to collaborate productively with domain specialists.
  • For the Research Scientist profile: evidence of selecting valuable research questions, developing or adapting methods, and designing experiments that yield defensible conclusions. You should be able to prototype and test your ideas.
  • For the Research Engineer profile: evidence of building reliable research software, evaluation infrastructure or agent systems that enable reproducible experiments and efficient iteration. You should be able to contribute to experimental design and interpretation.

Bonus Points For

  • Automated red teaming, adversarial testing or evaluation-method research.
  • Scientific AI, tool-using agents, laboratory automation or other complex environments.
  • Experience with safety monitoring, model-based evaluators or scalable experimental infrastructure.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range
$180,000—$298,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. title: Product Expert – Veeva RIM Submissions, Archive, and Publishing
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role 
Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with real-world life science industry experience in Regulatory Operations or Regulatory Affairs to drive customer success with our Veeva Regulatory Information Management (RIM) products in Europe. If you are a person who has a blend of experience building regulatory submissions and understanding of the key technical product features behind these processes, then this could be the role for you!
 
Product Experts play a key role in the product organization, supporting software product managers specialising in Submissions, Submissions Archive and Publishing applications. You will advocate the voice of the customer by creating problem statements, using a blend of your industry knowledge, experience with European/ ROW regulations, and an understanding of real need behind the ask, to help shape the product roadmap for Submissions, Submissions Archive, and Publishing. Product Experts build strong relationships within the Veeva RIM community, lead educational campaigns, create content to showcase Veeva RIM, and represent the product organization in online communities, customer meetings and at industry events.
 
This role is ideal for someone passionate about RIM processes, eager to collaborate with customers from end users to executives, and excited to drive their success. You should have the skills and personal characteristics to work with autonomy, proactiveness and drive – demonstrating the ability to succeed where there is ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.
 #RemoteGermany #LI-Associate Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

description:
Position Overview 

We are seeking Registered Respiratory Therapists to serve as Subject Matter Experts for an AI-powered learning platform supporting learners preparing for respiratory therapy credentialing and practice. 

Primary Responsibilities 

  • Evaluate AI-generated content related to cardiopulmonary anatomy and physiology, patient assessment, airway management, oxygen and aerosol therapy, mechanical ventilation, arterial blood gas interpretation, pulmonary function testing, and respiratory pharmacology 
  • Review content on neonatal, pediatric, and adult critical care respiratory management and common cardiopulmonary disease states 
  • Apply structured evaluation metrics to score accuracy, completeness, and clinical applicability

  • Complete asynchronous evaluations within defined timelines (5 days to 2 weeks) 
  • Participate in periodic evaluation cycles with potential for ad-hoc assignments 

Required Qualifications 

  • Current Registered Respiratory Therapist (RRT) credential through the National Board for Respiratory Care (NBRC) 
  • Active state respiratory care license (where required by state) in good standing 
  • Graduate of a CoARC-accredited respiratory therapy program (minimum associate degree) 
  • Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in respiratory therapy education, clinical preceptorship, or content review 
  • NBRC specialty credential (e.g., NPS, ACCS, SDS) or experience in critical care, neonatal/pediatric, or pulmonary diagnostics 
  • Familiarity with the NBRC TMC and Clinical Simulation exam content outlines 

Time Commitment 

5–15 hours/week (Minimum quarterly participation) 

Project Details  

  • Duration: 1 year contract (subject to annual renewal) starting ASAP
  • Compensation: $55/hr 
  • Contract Structure: W2 position contracted through a 3rd party agency

description:
Support Worker within Learning Disability Services

LOCATION: Bristol

PAY RATES: £16.81 - £21.01 per hour (including holiday pay).

Shifts - flexible and available to work across a variety of shifts, including days, nights, and weekends. You must be able to complete short drop-in shifts at least a few times per week.

Make a lasting impact by building meaningful relationships.

At Thornbury Community Services (TCS), we believe exceptional care starts with genuine connections. We’re looking for Support Worker within Learning Disability Services who are committed to making a real difference—people who truly care and want to build long-term partnerships with those they support.

This isn’t just a job; it’s an opportunity to empower an individual with Cerebral Palsy & Learning Disability to live safe, fulfilled lives. You’ll help clients achieve personal goals, explore new hobbies, and enjoy trips into the community—all while creating relationships that bring lasting satisfaction for both you and them.

We are looking for a compassionate and patient Support Worker to support a gentleman to live an active and fulfilling life. This role involves providing personal care, including assistance with hoisting, showering, toileting, mobility, and medication support. Experience with medication administration is essential. You will support him to enjoy his interests, including sports, technology, creative storytelling, gardening, and accessing the local community. You will also provide encouragement with exercise and support him to explore new opportunities and hobbies.

We're looking for someone with excellent communication skills, a positive approach, and the ability to give time and reassurance when supporting decision-making and choices. A good sense of humour and a person-centered approach are key to success in this rewarding role.

What You’ll Do

· Deliver person-centered care within the client’s own home.

· Maintain safety whilst making positive risk decisions.

· Enrich life and promote independence.

· Build trust and long-term relationships that make every day meaningful.

What We Offer

We value our support workers and provide a benefits package designed to help you thrive:

· Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) – confidential wellbeing support.

· Travel and mileage expenses – reimbursed for your shifts.

· Exceptional pay rates – among the highest in the UK.

· Bespoke training and competency development – keep growing in your career.

We want passionate, resilient professionals who can commit to delivering care without exception. To join our team, you’ll need:

· Confidence in maintaining risk and using physical intervention where required.

· Strong personal values and ethical standards.

· Dedication, commitment and stability.

· A genuine desire to build lasting relationships and make a positive impact.

Why Choose TCS?

Joining Thornbury means joining a compassionate team that values people—not just as clients, but as individuals. You’ll enjoy job satisfaction, and the chance to make a difference that lasts.

Apply Today

Ready to start a role where care goes beyond tasks and becomes a relationship? Click Apply Now and our team will be in touch.

title: Lead Technical Data Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role
As a Team Lead, Technical Data Analyst you will serve as a player-coach - guiding a team of analysts while also executing complex data work yourself. At this level, you are developing your people management skills while leveraging your product, industry, and technical knowledge to advance. You will be the technical anchor for your team, providing the daily guidance needed to navigate complex data challenges and meet project deadlines. You take the vision set by leadership and turn it into reality, ensuring the team stays aligned with our core processes. Your focus is on problem-solving and technical steering, acting as the first line of support to ensure your team's success. This role focused on the functional coaching and project delivery.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide functional leadership and daily operational guidance to the team within the technical data function
  • Execute hands-on contribution to projects through data migration and data transformation using Python-based ETL tools.
  • Manage the team’s work allocation and coordinate activities to ensure results are driven by the team in collaboration with others.
  • Guide the team in issue resolution and escalate blockers proactively, maintaining alignment with stakeholders.
  • Support career development by providing continuous feedback loops on technical and project execution
  • Identify and drive opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and automation for greater efficiency.

Who You Are

  • Experience: 2+ years of related experience and a Bachelor’s degree, or 2+ years and a Master’s degree.
  • Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of portfolio, wealth, or investment management and financial data structures.
  • Technical Skills: Proficient in Python and knowledgeable in ETL workflows and data transformation logic.
  • Communication: Strong communication skills, able to conduct technical presentations and convey complex ideas clearly.
  • Organization: Highly organized with attention to detail, able to coordinate activities and deliver results that may impact schedules and costs.
  • Mindset: Solutions-driven mindset with a desire to improve processes and a commitment to personal growth in people management

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. Our unified, cloud-native platform delivers powerful automation, rapid value, and end-to-end visibility across the entire M365 ecosystem. In this role, you’ll blend strong technical skills on M365 and cloud administration with client-facing consulting excellence.
